{
  "name": "sounds",
  "version": "0.6.1",
  "description": "Toasts, configurable sounds and system notifications for Claude Code: usage limits, context, prompt-cache expiry, every way a turn ends, questions and permission prompts waiting and PR checks finishing (Claude mod)",
  "author": {
    "name": "giocaizzi",
    "url": "https://github.com/giocaizzi"
  },
  "repository": "https://github.com/giocaizzi/harness",
  "license": "MIT",
  "keywords": [
    "sounds",
    "notifications",
    "mod",
    "claude-code"
  ],
  "types": "./types/index.d.ts",
  "userConfig": {
    "soundLimit5h": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Sound: 5-hour limit",
      "description": "Plays when the 5-hour window passes 80%, 90% and 100%.",
      "required": false,
      "default": "warn",
      "options": [
        "off",
        "chime",
        "ping",
        "alert",
        "warn",
        "error",
        "done",
        "tick"
      ]
    },
    "soundLimit7d": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Sound: 7-day limit",
      "description": "Plays when the 7-day window passes 80%, 90% and 100%.",
      "required": false,
      "default": "warn",
      "options": [
        "off",
        "chime",
        "ping",
        "alert",
        "warn",
        "error",
        "done",
        "tick"
      ]
    },
    "soundLimitSpend": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Sound: spend limit",
      "description": "Plays when a gateway spend limit passes 80%, 90% and 100%.",
      "required": false,
      "default": "warn",
      "options": [
        "off",
        "chime",
        "ping",
        "alert",
        "warn",
        "error",
        "done",
        "tick"
      ]
    },
    "soundContext": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Sound: context",
      "description": "Plays when the context window passes 80% and 90%.",
      "required": false,
      "default": "alert",
      "options": [
        "off",
        "chime",
        "ping",
        "alert",
        "warn",
        "error",
        "done",
        "tick"
      ]
    },
    "soundCacheExpiring": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Sound: cache expiring",
      "description": "Plays one minute before the prompt cache expires.",
      "required": false,
      "default": "ping",
      "options": [
        "off",
        "chime",
        "ping",
        "alert",
        "warn",
        "error",
        "done",
        "tick"
      ]
    },
    "soundCacheExpired": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Sound: cache expired",
      "description": "Plays when the prompt cache has expired.",
      "required": false,
      "default": "warn",
      "options": [
        "off",
        "chime",
        "ping",
        "alert",
        "warn",
        "error",
        "done",
        "tick"
      ]
    },
    "soundDone": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Sound: turn finished",
      "description": "Plays when a turn ends with an answer and took at least the seconds below.",
      "required": false,
      "default": "done",
      "options": [
        "off",
        "chime",
        "ping",
        "alert",
        "warn",
        "error",
        "done",
        "tick"
      ]
    },
    "soundAborted": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Sound: turn interrupted",
      "description": "Plays when a turn is interrupted, including a message sent mid-turn instead of queued.",
      "required": false,
      "default": "off",
      "options": [
        "off",
        "chime",
        "ping",
        "alert",
        "warn",
        "error",
        "done",
        "tick"
      ]
    },
    "soundRefused": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Sound: model refused",
      "description": "Plays when the model refuses a turn.",
      "required": false,
      "default": "error",
      "options": [
        "off",
        "chime",
        "ping",
        "alert",
        "warn",
        "error",
        "done",
        "tick"
      ]
    },
    "soundError": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Sound: API error",
      "description": "Plays when an API error or the context limit ends a turn.",
      "required": false,
      "default": "error",
      "options": [
        "off",
        "chime",
        "ping",
        "alert",
        "warn",
        "error",
        "done",
        "tick"
      ]
    },
    "soundSubagent": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Sound: subagent finished",
      "description": "Plays when a subagent finishes a turn.",
      "required": false,
      "default": "tick",
      "options": [
        "off",
        "chime",
        "ping",
        "alert",
        "warn",
        "error",
        "done",
        "tick"
      ]
    },
    "soundNeedsInput": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Sound: needs input",
      "description": "Plays when Claude waits on you: a permission prompt or a question.",
      "required": false,
      "default": "chime",
      "options": [
        "off",
        "chime",
        "ping",
        "alert",
        "warn",
        "error",
        "done",
        "tick"
      ]
    },
    "doneAfterSeconds": {
      "type": "number",
      "title": "Sound: shortest turn",
      "description": "Turns shorter than this many seconds do not play the finished sound; 0 plays after every answer.",
      "required": false,
      "default": 0
    },
    "soundGain": {
      "type": "number",
      "title": "Sound volume",
      "description": "Linear gain from 0 to 4.",
      "required": false,
      "default": 1
    },
    "notify": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Notify: system notifications",
      "description": "Send a system notification when a long turn finishes or ends badly, when Claude asks a question, and when the PR checks finish (with the hud plugin).",
      "required": false,
      "default": true
    },
    "notifyAfterSeconds": {
      "type": "number",
      "title": "Notify: shortest turn",
      "description": "Turns shorter than this many seconds raise no 'finished' notification.",
      "required": false,
      "default": 60
    }
  }
}
